mLocKeys.keySummary: Ashe gains stacks of <spellName>Focus</spellName> while out-of-combat. When Ashe has 100 stacks of <spellName>Focus</spellName>, her next basic Attack will critically strike.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ashe gains stacks of <spellName>Focus</spellName> while out-of-combat. When Ashe has 100 stacks of <spellName>Focus</spellName>, her next basic Attack will critically strike.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Focus</titleLeft><mainText>Ashe gains <spellName>Focus</spellName> while not attacking. At 100 stacks her next Attack will critically strike.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line.  If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion for up to 3.5 seconds, based on how far the arrow has traveled.  In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Ashe launches a crystal arrow of ice in a line that <status>Stuns</status> an enemy Champion dealing <magicDamage>@RMainDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. <status>Stun</status> duration increases with distance travelled, up to @MaxStunDuration@ seconds. Surrounding enemies are <status>Slowed</status> by @MovementSpeedMod*-100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds and take <magicDamage>@RAoEDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.

mLocKeys.keySummary: While active, each of Ashe's basic attacks slow her targets. This drains Mana with each attack.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText><toggle>Toggle:</toggle> Basic Attacks <status>Slow</status> enemies by @SlowPercent*-100@% over @SlowDuration@ seconds.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Each time Ashe kills a unit, she gains some extra gold. Ashe can activate to send her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Ashe gains @AdditionalGold@ extra gold whenever she kills an enemy.

Active: Ashe sends forth a hawk to grant vision in an area for @RevealDuration@ seconds. It also reveals the area as it flies through.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Ashe fires 7 arrows in a cone for increased damage.  Volley also applies Ashe's current level of Frost Shot.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Fires arrows in a cone, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. <spellName>Volley</spellName> applies <spellName>Frost Shot's</spellName> <status>Slow</status> effect.</mainText>
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Fires arrows in a cone, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage. Volley applies Frost Shot's Slow effect.

Enemies hit by multiple arrows only take damage from the first.
